file_name: Calvary - 14 Healthscope hospitals and Healthscope Independence Services - Questionnaire - 30 October 2026.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any Calvary-operated hospitals and any of the Target Hospitals are close competitors in the relevant geographic region in which they operate. In your response, you may wish to consider factors such as the services and specialities available at each hospital, medical officers, facilities, location, quality of care, safety, innovation and pricing.

Please list any other hospitals, including day surgeries, that compete with the Calvary-operated hospitals and the Target Hospitals in the relevant geographic regions identified in response to question
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition, including in relation to the acquisition of Healthscope Independence Services.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Calvary and/or Healthscope.
